entities.name: GlmU
observations: 440-aa query has 61.3% identity and 97.3% query coverage to reviewed GlmU A9HI46; assignment is homology-supported.
Bifunctional enzyme catalyzes acetylation of glucosamine-1-phosphate and UTP-dependent uridylyl transfer to form UDP-GlcNAc.
Reference annotation reports Mg2+ binding; cytoplasmic localization in the homolog.

entities.name: RHEA:13725
observations: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+; acetyltransferase activity (EC 2.3.1.157).

entities.name: RHEA:13509
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate; uridylyltransferase activity (EC 2.7.7.23).
